description: Get a link where the user (or their photographer) uploads photos from their phone or computer into a property. No login, valid 24 hours. Use this whenever the photos are files on the user's device that weren't attached to the chat: for editing, videos or virtual tours. Regular photos and 360° photos both work (360° photos are recognised automatically); pass type "360" for a virtual tour so anything else is refused. Creates the property if no propertyId is given. Give the user the uploadUrl, wait until they say they're done, then use pedra_list_property_images (type "360" for 360° photos), or pedra_create_virtual_tour with the propertyId. (With this local server, files on this computer can also be passed directly: a local path as imageUrl, or pedra_add_local_panoramas for 360° photos.)

language.description: Language of the tour page and of AI room names. Defaults to "en".

name.description: Name for the new property, e.g. the listing address. Ignored when propertyId is given.

propertyId.description: Property to upload into (from pedra_list_properties). Omit to create a new one.

type.description: "any" (default) takes photos and 360° photos; "360" only takes 360° photos.

name: pedra_create_upload_link
title: Create photo upload link
